title: SBOM step in CI
goal: CI attaches a CycloneDX SBOM from the lock file
acceptance: `ci.yml` generates the SBOM and uploads it as an artifact, action pinned by SHA
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 0.5 h per repository. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
